title: AI Research Intern
bullets: Built a MobileNetV2 regression model with transfer learning for real-time banana spoilage estimation, reaching R² = 0.91 across 5 ripeness stages and outperforming VGG19 and MobileNetV3 baselines.
Created and published a custom longitudinal computer-vision dataset on Mendeley Data; flipping, rotation and brightness augmentation expanded it to 1,200+ annotated images.
Benchmarked 3 CNN architectures using loss-curve analysis and co-authored a research paper, now in progress for peer-reviewed journal submission.
